dedupe_keys.name: pssimpy large value payment and settlement system simulator

description: An open-source Python library that simulates large-value payment systems. The GitHub README says PSSimPy simulates large-value payment systems with synthetic or real transaction data to test changes and their effect on system performance, for researchers and industry or government analysts. Users define banks, accounts and transactions, and can add bank failures at set times as a stress test, model banks as strategic agents, and customise queues, credit facilities, transaction fees and constraint handlers. It installs with pip and is free under the MIT licence; the paper is See, Shobri and Garcia, ICIS 2024. Coverage is any system the user sets up. Caveats: real transaction data must come from the user. For simulation it shows how a participant outage spreads liquidity shortfalls and settlement delays through an RTGS system. A related catalogue record is the BoF-PSS2 payment and settlement simulator.
